scope: Read-only original-source research for named experimental Windows 11 recipes. No OS writes, runtime promotion, catalog edits, commits, or remote mutations.

targetDevice.localEvidence: src/ViVeUI.Windows/MainWindow.xaml.cs BuildText currently formats Environment.OSVersion.Version, without an independent UBR read. Therefore displayed .0 is not evidence of the servicing revision.
targetDevice.interpretation: The displayed base build alone cannot match these exact observations; it also does not distinguish older Dev flights from the 25H2 servicing branch.

provenanceRule: Feature purpose and exact numeric recipes are supported by the original discoverer posts, re-read through the public API with CID and author captured. Official Microsoft announcements independently corroborate purpose and build context, not the numeric override mechanism.

buildContext.fact: The Microsoft release table lists 25H2 general availability at 26200.6584 on 2025-09-30 and many subsequent serviced revisions. The same 26200 base is not a single immutable runtime.
buildContext.inference: An exact reported Dev observation is neither a minimum build nor proof of continuing support on later 25H2 revisions.

rejectedForThisTarget.reason: Known obsolete/fragile Explorer tabs and navigation rollback combination. Original ExplorerPatcher discussion reports Explorer crashes on 22621.2361; maintainer reports TIFE removed in Dev 23575. Do not promote these for 26200.
Movable/smaller taskbar original post explicitly reports 26300.8493, not 26200. Two independently named functions, not a required pair.
Customizable context-menu original post explicitly reports Experimental 26340.9212, not 26200; not a Windows 10 classic-menu replacement.
